snippet.description:
Learn Total Derivatives, Partial Differentiation, Chain Rule for composite functions, and Change of Variables in Hindi. Complete B.Sc 1st Year Maths lecture with step-by-step solved examples and proofs.

Is complete lecture mein hum cover karenge Total Derivatives (सम्पूर्ण अवकल गुणांक) aur Chain Rule / Change of Variables (चरों का परिवर्तन) for composite functions.

Agar aap B.Sc. 1st Year (Calculus / Differential Calculus), B.Sc. B.Ed., IIT JAM, ya CSIR NET Maths ki taiyari kar rahe hain, toh yeh lecture aapke concepts clear karne ke liye essential hai. Is video mein basic concepts se lekar important standard proofs aur examination problems ko step-by-step solve kiya gaya hai.

📌 Topics Covered in this Video:
Introduction to Composite Functions (संयुक्त फलन)
Chain Rule for Single & Two Variables (श्रृंखला नियम)
Total Derivative Formula & Meaning ($du/dt$)
Change of Variables Concept (चरों का परिवर्तन)
Euler's Theorem Extension for 3 Variables
Polar Coordinates Transformation ($x = r\cos\theta, y = r\sin\theta$) & Derivatives
Step-by-Step Solved University Exam Problems

Timestamps
00:00 - Recap of Euler’s Theorem for Homogeneous Functions
01:00 - Definition of Composite Functions
05:08 - Differentiation of Composite Functions & Chain Rule
09:16 - Change of Variables (Two Independent Variables)
12:33 - Total Derivatives & Generalized Chain Rule ($n$-Variables)
15:00 - Example 1
23:21 - Example 2
30:50 - Example 3
38:23 - Example 4: Proof of Euler’s Theorem for 3 Variables Using Change of Variables
47:36 - Example 5: Transformations & Partial Derivatives in Polar Coordinates
56:30 - Summary & Next Lecture Preview

🎓 Yeh Video Kin Ke Liye Useful Hai:
🔸B.Sc, B.Sc B.Ed, Maths students 
🔸B.Tech Engineering Maths 
🔸GATE Mathematics 
🔸IIT JAM Mathematics

🔗 Previous Lecture:
Partial Differentiation: Euler's Theorem Important Examples → https://youtu.be/NOixwSoRNHg

📺 Complete Playlist:
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLQ2PtdP6tVW8

Video pasand aaye toh Like karein aur Fractal Frontier Maths channel ko Subscribe karna na bhoolein. Koi bhi doubt ho toh comments mein zarur batayein!

📚 RECOMMENDED BOOKS / STUDY MATERIAL
If you want to study this topic in more depth, the following books are very helpful:

📘 Thomas' Calculus (15th Edition) – George B. Thomas, Maurice D. Weir & Joel R. Hass
👉 https://amzn.to/48DQjQW

📘 Single Variable Calculus (Hardcover) – James Stewart
👉 https://amzn.to/4cQeZbk

📘 Differential Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cRttb2

📘 Integral Calculus – Shanti Narayan & P.K. Mittal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cReFsT

📘 Calculus, Vol. 1: One-Variable Calculus, with an Introduction to Linear Algebra – Tom M. Apostol
👉 https://amzn.to/4mBuoQ9

📘Higher Engineering Mathematics — B.S. Grewal
👉 https://amzn.to/4cz7dS7

📘Advanced Engineering Mathematics — Erwin Kreyszig
👉 https://amzn.to/41FY1pW

📘 Mathematical Methods for Physics and Engineering — K.F. Riley
👉 https://amzn.to/42cW0Sf

📘 Schaum’s Outline of Calculus
👉 https://amzn.to/4u0oxqd

Agar video helpful lage toh LIKE karein, channel ko SUBSCRIBE karein aur apne classmates ke saath SHARE karein! Koi bhi doubts ya questions ho toh comments section mein zaroor batayein.

Happy Learning! 📐✨
